svg.text: 01 / USB-C EPR Power and USB Data
J1 carries 48 V / 5 A EPR power and USB 2.0 device data on one USB-C receptacle.
U1: 48 V CC/VBUS and D+/D- protection. U2: TPS26750 EPR sink controller. U3: PD policy EEPROM. U4: hardware power-permit gate.
R107/R108/C72: 5-60 V attach sense. Q1: protected VBUS control. Q2/Q3: PD-path level translation.
